# nemau completion zsh

Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

```
echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" >> ~/.zshrc
```

To load completions in your current shell session:

```
source <(nemau completion zsh)
```

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

```
nemau completion zsh > "${fpath[1]}/_nemau"
```

#### macOS:

```
nemau completion zsh > $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_nemau
```

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

## Usage

```
nemau completion zsh [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --no-descriptions   disable completion descriptions
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
